usedFor: Shopify records the shopper and Bouncer checks the address, so “Abandoned Checkout” can feed “Verify Email”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Verify Email” in Bouncer
bestTemplate.why: It checks whether the shopper's email is deliverable before you spend a follow-up on it.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so “Verify Email” runs after a scheduled check.
